cards.prompt: According to Naval Ravikant, how many types of luck are there?
cards.answer: Four: blind, hustle, skill and unique luck.

cards.prompt: Luck that comes because you work so hard and stay busy that luck eventually finds you is called what?
cards.answer: Hustle luck: your effort makes luck find you.

cards.prompt: I happen outside your control, with no intervention from you, and people often call me fate. Which type of luck am I?
A veteran designer spots a rare opportunity others miss, thanks to years of knowledge and experience. Which type of luck is this?
cards.answer: Skill luck: being very good in your field helps you recognise luck when it shows up.
cards.explanation: Naval's idea: statistically, luck can be created.

cards.prompt: Luck can only ever be pure chance; you can never create it.
cards.answer: Statistically, luck can be created, e.g. through hustle, skill and unique attributes.
